author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The proof is a two-case dichotomy on the image c of a unit u of A in K: if c is in B then u is in R; otherwise c^{-1} is in B by the valuation-ring dichotomy lemma and u^{-1} is in R. H2: single named algebra fact applied in two cases.
